section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，包括箱体，所述箱体内安装有隔板，所述隔板的上部一侧安装有待检测材料盒，所述待检测材料盒的上端面贯穿箱体并连接安装有进液管，所述待检测材料盒的底部安装有输送管，所述输送管的下端安装有基因检测仪，所述待检测材料盒的右侧安装有水箱，所述水箱的下部安装有清洗喷头，所述隔板的下部且在箱体侧壁安装有加热管，所述加热管的外部安装有传导层，所述箱体的底端一侧开设有污水排口，所述箱体的外部前端开设有操作口，所述操作口上滑动安装有密封挡板。本实用新型整体设计合理，实现了整体设备的清洗消毒，保证了该设备的基因检测结果的准确性。

The utility model discloses a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering, the power distribution box comprises a box body, install the baffle in the box, the upper portion one side of baffle is installed and is detected the material box, the up end that detects the material box runs through the box and connects and install the feed liquor pipe, detect the bottom of detecting the material box and install the conveyer pipe, gene detector is installed to the lower extreme of conveyer pipe, detect the right side of detecting the material box and install the water tank, the washing shower nozzle is installed to the lower part of water tank, the heating pipe is just installed at the box lateral wall in the lower part of baffle, the externally mounted of heating pipe has the conducting layer, sewage row mouth has been seted up to bottom one side of box, the operation mouth has been seted up to the outside front end of box, slidable mounting. The utility model has the advantages of reasonable overall design, realized the cleaning and disinfection of whole equipment, guaranteed the accuracy of the gene testing result of this equipment.

Gene detection equipment for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a gene detection related equipment technical field specifically is a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering.

Background

The gene is a genetic basic unit, carries DNA or RNA sequence of genetic information, transmits the genetic information to the next generation through replication, and guides the synthesis of protein to express the genetic information carried by the gene, thereby controlling the character expression of organism individuals. The gene detection is a technique for detecting DNA by blood, other body fluids or cells, and is a method for taking peripheral venous blood or other tissue cells of a detected person, amplifying the gene information, detecting DNA molecular information in the cells of the detected person by a specific device, and analyzing whether the gene type, the gene defect and the expression function contained in the DNA molecular information are normal or not, so that people can know the gene information of themselves, determine the cause of disease or predict the risk of the body suffering from a certain disease, and the gene detection can diagnose the disease and can also be used for predicting the risk of the disease.

At present, the gene detection equipment adopted in the prior art does not consider the error of the next gene detection caused by the cleaning and disinfection of the equipment after the operation of the gene detection is finished every time, so that the detection result is inaccurate.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering to solve the problem that proposes among the above-mentioned background art.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a gene detection device for biological gene engineering comprises a box body, wherein a partition plate is welded and installed in the box body, a material box to be detected is installed on one side of the upper portion of the partition plate, the upper end face of the material box to be detected penetrates through the box body and is connected with and provided with a liquid inlet pipe, a conveying pipe is installed at the bottom of the material box to be detected, a gene detector is installed at the lower end of the conveying pipe, a water tank is installed on the right side of the material box to be detected and on the partition plate, a water inlet connector is connected and installed on the upper end face of the water tank, a cleaning nozzle is installed on the lower portion of the water tank, heating pipes are installed on the lower portion of the partition plate and on the side wall of the box body and are in spiral distribution, a conduction layer is installed outside the, the both sides of operation mouth just the surface mounting of box has a set of guide rail, slidable mounting has sealing baffle on the guide rail.

Preferably, the port of the liquid inlet pipe is rotatably provided with a rubber plug.

Preferably, a set of handles is mounted on the top of the outer part of the box body.

Preferably, rubber cushion blocks are bonded to four end corners of the bottom of the box body.

Preferably, a rubber plug plate is arranged on the sewage discharge port.

Preferably, the sliding blocks are installed on two sides of the bottom of the sealing baffle.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: the liquid inlet pipe through waiting to detect the material box will wait to examine the test agent injection and wait to detect in the material box, open sealing baffle after that, the test agent of waiting to examine is carried in operation mouth department through the conveyer pipe to gene detector, make and wait to examine test agent and gene probe contact, detect through gene detector, after detection operation accomplishes, take out gene detector, begin to carry out cleaning and disinfection to the box inner chamber, sealing baffle needs to be closed this moment, water supply connector external water pipe, it sprays the washing to launch pump body operation cleaning shower nozzle in the water tank, open rubber cock board after a period and discharge sewage from sewage row mouth, then launch the heating pipe of spiral distribution, disinfect when high temperature is dried, in order to ensure next operation.

The utility model has the advantages of simple overall structure, reasonable in design, the practicality is strong, has realized the cleaning and disinfecting of whole equipment, easy operation, and convenient to use has guaranteed the accuracy of the gene testing result of this equipment, has advantages such as excellent in use effect.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-3, the present invention provides a technical solution: a gene detection device for biological gene engineering comprises a box body 1, a partition plate 2 is welded and installed in the box body 1, a material box 3 to be detected is installed on one side of the upper portion of the partition plate 2, the upper end face of the material box 3 to be detected penetrates through the box body 1 and is connected with and provided with a liquid inlet pipe 4, a conveying pipe 5 is installed at the bottom of the material box 3 to be detected, a gene detector 6 is installed at the lower end of the conveying pipe 5, a water tank 7 is installed on the right side of the material box 3 to be detected and is arranged on the partition plate 2, a water inlet connector 8 is connected and installed on the upper end face of the water tank 7, a cleaning spray head 9 is installed on the lower portion of the water tank 7, heating pipes 10 are installed on the side wall of the box body 1 and are spirally distributed on the lower portion of the partition plate 2, a conduction layer 11 is installed outside the heating pipes 10, a sewage discharge port, a sealing baffle 15 is arranged on the guide rail 14 in a sliding way;

the port of the liquid inlet pipe 4 is rotatably provided with a rubber plug, the external top end of the box body 1 is provided with a group of handles 16, four end corners at the bottom of the box body 1 are bonded with rubber cushion blocks, a rubber plug plate is arranged on the sewage discharge port 12, two sides of the bottom of the sealing baffle 15 are both provided with slide blocks 17, a test agent to be tested is injected into the material box 3 to be tested through the liquid inlet pipe 4 of the material box 3 to be tested, then the sealing baffle 15 is opened, the test agent to be tested is conveyed into the gene detector 6 through the conveying pipe 5 at the operation port 13, so that the test agent to be tested is contacted with the gene probe and is detected by the gene detector 6, after the detection operation is finished, the gene detector 6 is taken out, the cleaning and disinfection of the inner cavity of the box body 1 are started, at the moment, the sealing baffle 15 needs to be closed, open rubber cock board after a period and discharge sewage from sewage row mouth 12, then launch spiral distributed heating pipe 10, disinfect when high temperature is dried to ensure next operation, the utility model has the advantages of simple overall structure, reasonable in design, the practicality is strong, has realized whole equipment's cleaning and disinfection, easy operation, and convenient to use has guaranteed the accuracy of this equipment's gene testing result, has excellent in use effect.

The working principle is as follows: the utility model discloses a when using, will wait to examine the test agent injection through the feed liquor pipe 4 that waits to detect material box 3 and wait to detect in material box 3, open seal baffle 15 after that, examine the test agent through conveyer pipe 5 to gene detector 6 interior transport in operation mouth 13 department, make and wait to examine test agent and gene probe contact, detect through gene detector 6, after detection operation accomplishes, take out gene detector 6, begin to carry out cleaning and disinfection to box 1 inner chamber, seal baffle 15 need be closed this moment, water supply connector 8 external water pipe, pump body operation washing shower nozzle 9 sprays the washing in launching water tank 7, open the rubber cock board after a period and discharge sewage from sewage discharge opening 12, then launch spiral distribution's heating pipe 10, disinfect when high temperature drying, in order to ensure next operation, the device overall design is reasonable, has easy operation, Convenient use, good use effect and the like.
